Messages.Author: PRAND
Messages.Body:
I was wondering: How much damage does a weapon (sawed- off shotgun, for
example) do if it doesn't say? Does it just do 1, or is there some other
way to determine this? I would really appreciate it if whoever reads this
would respond, because it could greatly affect our games.
Thanks, prand (Paul Rand).

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


There are no weapons which do not say how much damage they do.
The Shotgun does 3 damage, usable at range (or at close), once per combat.
It may not be used for a strike more than once per combat.
